title: Advt. No. 30/2026 - Re-employment of Retired Government Employees
organization: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
age_limit: Maximum age limit of 65 years on the date of walk-in-interview
summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has invited applications from retired government employees of Indian Railways through walk-in-interview for re-employment on a need-based contract basis in the OP&BD department. The deployment is initially for a period of one year, extendable based on requirements and performance.
eligibility_bullets: JGM (OP&BD): Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13
DGM (OP&BD): Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12

vacancy_breakdown.eligibility: Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13
vacancy_breakdown.notes: 1 post in OCC/ADI, 1 post in OCC/PRYJ

vacancy_breakdown.eligibility: Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12
vacancy_breakdown.notes: 1 post in Noida unit, 1 post in Mumbai unit

how_to_apply_steps: Check eligibility criteria for the desired post and prepare the prescribed application form with a recent self-attested passport-size photograph.

Gather original and self-attested copies of required documents including PPO (as per 7th CPC), Service Certificate, Last Pay Slip, Aadhar card, Cancel Cheque/Copy of Bank Passbook, and two photographs.
Attend the walk-in-interview on 08.12.2026 between 10:00 hrs. and 12:00 hrs. at DFCCIL Corporate Office, Near Sector 146 Metro Station, Sector-145, Noida UP - 201306.
